title: Co-administration Study in Patients With Elevated Cholesterol and Coronary Heart Disease (0653-802)(COMPLETED)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate additional cholesterol lowering effects in patients with coronary heart disease by giving an investigational drug with a patient's current approved cholesterol lowering medication.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with elevated cholesterol and coronary heart disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have cholesterol levels within normal ranges as identified by the study
